name: Villalba (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Four unequal horizontal stripes of green, white, green and yellow, the white stripe with an embattled upper edge, and a white star with a tail in the upper hoist.
history: Villalba, originally known as Villa Alba, is a town and municipality of Puerto Rico located in the central region, northeast of Juana Díaz; south of Orocovis; and west of Coamo.

features.role: star of the shield with a tail
